integrity: Definitions, group action, stabilizer and fixed-point classification, face enumeration, Euler-characteristic computation and standard homotopy-theoretic consequences are explicitly proved in RESULT.md. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Full integral homology and fundamental group are determined for every prime-power field order; full homotopy type is established only in characteristic two. The nontrivial odd-characteristic Postnikov data and cohomology ring are not claimed. Exact finite chain calculations cover q=2,3,4 only; infinite proof is independent of enumeration.
title: Translation quotients of affine-plane matroid complexes: a characteristic-two homotopy transition
